statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is 22% after NQ set a lower overnight low at 30,564.50 without the repeated extension that would mark mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The narrow 12:30-15:00 UTC window around the jobless-claims block and the U.S. cash open is the evidence-based checkpoint; outside it the overnight structure has stayed two-sided.
headline: NQ grinds to a lower overnight low while the rates impulse stalls
body: NQ futures trade 30,618.75, down 146.00 points or 0.47%, inside an overnight range of 30,564.50 to 30,813.00 as of 06:16 UTC. The 30,564.50 print undercuts the 30,651.25 low that held earlier in the session, so the downside break that was rejected an hour ago has now extended; price has since retraced roughly 54 points off the new low rather than pressing it. ES futures are down 0.34%, a shade less than NQ, which keeps the move tech-led rather than a broad one-way risk-off. The rates channel that drove Wednesday's selloff has stalled: the 10-year is flat at 5.12% after reaching a 19-year high, the 2-year is 4.90%, the 5-year 5.01% and the 30-year 5.42%. WTI is $92.30 and Brent $103.27, both roughly unchanged, and VIX closed Wednesday at 15.18, a level that prices no sustained dislocation. Asia is mixed, with the Nikkei 225 up 1.3% while the Hang Seng is down 0.5%, the Shanghai Composite down 0.8% and the ASX 200 down 0.7%. The backdrop remains Wednesday's S&P Global flash composite PMI at 58.4, the strongest since July 2021, which revived October rate-hike expectations and closed the Nasdaq Composite 1.13% lower at 26,936.04. Tail moves from 19% to 22% on the lower low alone; the amplifiers that would justify more - shallow or failed retracements, repeated extension, aligned cross-assets - are absent, and the shared Finviz context was too stale for this session to add confirmation.

lookbackSummary: The last 24 hours carried a complete Claude assessment record. Tail ran 11-12% through Wednesday's European session, stepped to 25% at 14:00 UTC as the flash PMI drove yields to a 19-year high and the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.13%, then decayed through the U.S. close and overnight to 17-19% as the repricing was digested. The 04:00 UTC slot briefly read 22% on an overnight downside probe before returning to 19% when that probe was rejected.
outlookSummary: The current hour carries Tail at 22% on a lower overnight low that has not extended. Conditional risk holds in the watch band through the European session, steps to 23-24% across the 12:00-14:00 UTC block covering jobless claims, Fed speakers and the U.S. cash open, then decays through the afternoon with a small power-hour step up before returning to the 18-19% band overnight. No forecast hour assumes structure that is not observable at assessment time.
